programme.title: Post Credits
programme.sub-title: Why the Future of Entertainment Belongs to Creators | Rich Greenfield
programme.desc: Creators are gaining more power in entertainment. Could AI accelerate that shift faster than Hollywood is ready for? Media and technology analyst Rich Greenfield joins Ian Schafer on Post Credits to discuss why more value is flowing toward creators, why he believes YouTube remains unmatched at turning that opportunity into lasting success, and what other platforms still haven’t figured out. Greenfield also makes the case that we’re approaching one of the most explosive periods of content creation yet. As AI tools help more people produce increasingly sophisticated work, he sees the line between Hollywood and creator-led entertainment becoming harder to draw. What happens when more creators can make professional-quality content—and the platforms need them more than ever?

Lil Miller and Killer must return home and finish what they started. Theirs a new Queen Pin in town and she is out for a vengeance.

programme.title: Water
programme.desc: When known rapper Poetic Rhymes goes to jail, he encounters an unusual cellmate that alters his views on reality. When he is released from prison, his new visions and knowledge begins to affect those he loves the most.

programme.title: The House on Adams Drive
programme.desc: Sean is convinced the only way to keep the woman of his dreams happy is by obtaining as much money as possible. His friend Kordell, who’s an adult film star, helps him with a way to make a lot of money overnight. When they’re sent to a house to possibly film a scene, that turns out to be a real life exorcism.

programme.title: Induced
programme.desc: An expectant couple heads to a remote cabin to have a natural childbirth, but comes under attack from a predatory midwife who will stop at nothing to snatch their unborn child from them.

programme.title: Halloween Kickback
programme.desc: Three friends who went through college together find themselves in a financial bind after graduating college. They throw a Halloween party to raise money to get their lives on track.

programme.title: Induced 2
programme.desc: After a harrowing event that nearly kills Claudia, she and her husband try their best to move on. Claudia and Marcus then hire a new mid-wife to assist as they prepare for their new child. But they don’t know that Erica is lurking in the shadows, and she wants that baby.

programme.title: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: After visiting their late mother’s grave, Monica Anderson and her younger sister Angie try to settle back into a quiet evening at home. Their peace is shattered when news of a local serial killer breaks, and soon, a shadowy figure begins stalking them. What starts as eerie noises and fleeting glimpses escalates into a night of terror as the sisters are trapped inside their home with a cunning intruder who has cut off all escape.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Cougar
programme.desc: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it’s too late.

programme.title: The Betrayal 5: Kutthroat Fa Eva
programme.desc: Love, power, and revenge fuel the war between two rival gangs. As blood spills and alliances crumble, a forbidden romance continues to spark in the chaos. But the streets are buzzing with questions about the updates with TK! Is it all part of the plan, or the beginning of the end?

programme.title: Money Gang Lit
programme.desc: Hakeem Benson, a down-on-his-luck videographer, is evicted and adrift. He takes a risky music video gig for Bull Dawg, a notorious kingpin. But when a respected gang member is murdered, Hakeem is falsely accused and targeted. Now, in a city on fire, he's fighting for his life and meaning amidst the chaos.

programme.title: Who is She
programme.desc: Megan is a beautiful woman in search of love and acceptance but masks a tormented soul. Beneath the surface lies a volatile woman with multiple personalities and a dangerous capacity for violence.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Scandalous
programme.desc: Lady Watts, a bestselling author, reveals secrets about her affairs with those closest to her in her latest memoir. At her launch party, a heated argument turns violent, and she's left unconscious. As detectives investigate, secrets, love triangles, and betrayal emerge. The search for the attacker leads to twists and turns, involving everyone from her talent manager to her labelmate. The truth about the night of the attack is slowly revealed, with unexpected consequences for all involved.

programme.title: CODE
programme.desc: Dallas artist MALIK SCHAEFER, also known as CODE, is a rising star in the underground rap scene. Although his checkered past has led him down the wrong road at times, with the help of his best friend, STYLES, Malik is back on the fast-track to success. That is, until he reconnects with the dangerous love of his life, SOPHIA ORTEGA, who threatens to destroy it all. Malik must decide to either follow his heart or live by the code that has served him well for many years: family over everything.

programme.title: Trap A Fool
programme.desc: After two years of what he thought was a perfect relationship, Jeremiah uncovers his beloved Shay-Shay's "black book" of men. He is forced to realize that her gentle nature was a facade, a calculated move in her "game of fools." Shay-Shay's only loves are herself, sex, and money, and their dangerous game is about to end.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Shotlanta

He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

programme.title: Single Black Female

programme.title: Aliens in the Hood

programme.title: Toxic King

Will he fight for true love? Or resign to being a Toxic King?

She joins a local women’s group ran by Beverly Jordan a respected therapist to help process her emotions. When in reality, she’s there to rekindle an old flame with a former lover, who happens to be Beverly’s husband.

programme.desc: Detectives Trent Rollins and Latoya Cooper investigate a series of murders in which the victims all bear a mysterious symbol that’s connected to a previous murder of a known artist, Preston Sacher. As they close in, Rollins finds himself stuck between protecting his family, and doing what’s right.

programme.title: The Agony and the Ecstasy

When they involve Dr. Monica Gaye in the plot , she flips the script to survive. When they align themselves with one of the most powerful drug dealers in the game, their loyalties are tested, and the very commandments that once bound them start to break.

But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programme.title: The Offer

As tensions rise, secrets unravel, and old wounds reopen, the couple begins to fracture under the moral and emotional weight of the offer.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments

programme.title: The Past Never Dies
programme.desc: CASEY MARSH was born in captivity. Her mother, JANE, was abducted as a teenager and gave birth to Casey while she was being held by the kidnapper, TIMOTHY FAST. Jane eventually escaped when Casey was 6 years old. Timothy Fast was arrested and incarcerated. Ever since, Jane has struggled to regain a normal life for her and her daughter. For Casey, the memories of a childhood in captivity still haunt her. Jane, on the other hand, has seemingly moved on. She has re-married and is happy. When a number of local women start to go missing, Jane reveals to Casey that Timothy might have had an accomplice and wonders if he is involved. The kidnapping M.O. is eerily similar. Casey is furious that her mother has hidden this knowledge from her all this time. Then, Jane suddenly disappears. Has she been kidnapped again? Casey must face the demons of her past in order to find her mother before it’s too late.

programme.desc: The campers build a race car to help Sawyer relive his pro-racing days. Then, Nanny Num Nums comes to Lakebottom.

programme.desc: This year Lauri Nami joins the starting list, back after last year's injury in Romania

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: It’s the final day of the Strongman Champions League’s first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120–200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 10, Finland - World championship under 105 kilograms
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 15, Dubai World grand finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 16, Dubai World grand finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 1, Norway - World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 2, Germany - FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 14, Road to Mexico
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 15, Mexico - World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 16, Mexico - World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLASH & FIRE! ROOKIE AND THE FOX
programme.desc: Rookie seeks shelter from an approaching thunderstorm in a cave under a tree. But when he hears a strange noise from the inside, Rookie tries to retreat quietly but runs straight into Mama Fox, who growls at him to protect her baby inside the cave. Rookie moves aside and decides to leave despite the rain, when suddenly lightning strikes, setting the tree on fire. Immediately, Rookie uses his robo-arms as a water hose to extinguish it and save the little fox family.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.sub-title: "3 Bucks In 4 Years… And We Just Made This Stand Even Better"
programme.desc: On just 40 acres in Missouri, Mike has built one of the most consistent stand setups we’ve ever seen. He’s killed 3 mature bucks in 4 years from this ONE stand… and it’s not by accident. In this video, we break down exactly why this stand is so deadly—from access and wind to natural movement and terrain—and then take it a step further. We’re improving the setup with bedding thickets and hinge cutting to make it even harder for bucks to avoid. If you’re hunting a smaller property, this is a blueprint you can apply right now.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell. - GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: In this episode, Rush welcomes Cullen Lundholm from Cape Cod to experience Key West at its finest. Over several action-packed days, they target a variety of species in the incredible waters surrounding the Florida Keys. But the adventure doesn’t end at the dock—Cullen also experiences Key West’s world-class accommodations, exceptional food, and one-of-a-kind island lifestyle. From unforgettable fishing to first-class hospitality, this episode shows why Key West and the Florida Keys are among the world’s premier fishing and vacation destinations.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: We set out to tell the tale of Marion - and his legendary Mack’s Prairie Wings, smack dab in the middle of the world famous Stuttgart, Arkansas - the land of ducks and rice. Get an inside look at a man that many consider to be larger than life, from those that knew him best, like his cousin and fellow hell raiser, Bud McCollum. We’ll even hear a story or two from Milton Stovesand, an 81 year old former waterfowl guide and Mack’s employee who actually guided John Olin a time or two, and ran the timber holes with Marion. It’s timber holes and tall tales. It’s cups of coffee and cupped up wings. It’s partners in business, and partners in potholes and it’s pure Arkansas...just like Marion.

programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the world’s worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet – 231 miles per hour – was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a “human popsicle”, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Council’s high speed wind tunnel. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.title: FishON! | Weathering the Storm: Walleye on Porcupine Lake
programme.desc: In this exciting episode, we venture out onto Porcupine Lake for some beautiful walleye action with Craig Salmonson from Timmins Angling Adventures. Patience was key as we waited for a break in challenging weather conditions—but it all paid off with an unforgettable day on the water. Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Wired2Fish | Baits and Gear For the Biggest Catch
programme.desc: The team from Wired2Fish delivers the goods on how to catch the biggest fish—wherever or whenever you're casting lines.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Pour un air de country…
programme.desc: Jessie Lee Harris, chanteur star de country et acteur de westerns, fait une boucle pendant sa tournée et rend visite aux sauveteurs de Malibu pour retrouver sa femme et son fils, qu’il a perdu de vue.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Cas de conscience
programme.desc: En plein test d’une nouvelle machine volante, Mitch découvre un radeau avec à son bord une femme naufragée. Mitch doit venir en aide à l’étrangère et retrouver sa sœur. Au QG, Matt et Garner doivent s’occuper d’un couple d’arnaqueurs.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Une vie de star
programme.desc: Mitch sauve de la noyade Cassie Cole, une présentatrice d'un célèbre talk-show télévisé. Caroline et CJ adoptent un chien errant qui nageait dans l’océan. L’animal leur rappelle Stephanie.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: La sirène au violon
programme.desc: Cody prend une leçon amoureuse lorsque Mitch et lui viennent en aide à une belle violoniste qui cherche à échapper au joug de son agente. Alex veut prouver sa valeur en repassant l’examen d’entrée des sauveteurs avec Jessie.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Le cœur a ses raisons
programme.desc: Manny est hanté par son passé alors que deux jeunes délinquants venus de sa ville natale débarquent à Malibu pour du travail d’intérêt général. Neely remarque que Mitch et Samantha se rapprochent.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Guerre des nerfs
programme.desc: Mason Sato, un magnat de la drogue que Mitch a aidé à arrêter, est relâché de prison, et cherche à accomplir sa vengeance. Lorsque Sato kidnappe Hobie et Kaye, Mitch se retrouve confronté à un combat au sabre digne des plus grands samouraïs.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: L'inconnue de la plage
programme.desc: Mitch et Caroline sauvent une femme qui est atteinte d’amnésie à la suite d’une chute. Ils doivent retrouver son père pour l’aider à retrouver la mémoire. Pendant ce temps, CJ rencontre un homme en chaise roulante qui aimerait avoir un accès à la plage.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Coup de poker
programme.desc: Cody fait un pari fou et Mitch risque le Scarab de son oncle au cours d’une course à la conclusion inattendue. Neely et Ashley emménagent chez Mitch en attendant la fin des travaux de rénovation dans leur appartement.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Maigrir ou mourir
programme.desc: Eddie a un rendez-vous avec une femme en surpoids mais ses pilules coupe-faim se révèlent dangereuses… Pendant ce temps, la vie de Mitch est changée par l’irruption d’un chien errant, secouru en mer après le kidnapping de sa propriétaire.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Un futur champion
programme.desc: Cody met sa carrière et sa vie en danger lorsqu’il commence à prendre des substituts alimentaires afin de booster ses performances en vue des Jeux Olympiques de Sydney. Alex est au centre de l’attention de Newmie, alors qu’elle est rejetée par Mitch.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Mer de flammes
programme.desc: Un vagabond met le feu à la tour de garde d’Eddie, tandis que l’équipe découvre qu’un laboratoire pharmaceutique illégal distribue une nouvelle drogue. Mitch et Thorpe essaient de convaincre le conseil de la ville d’investir dans un nouveau jet-ski…

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Le Tremblement de terre
programme.desc: Gina est gravement blessée après un tremblement de terre, et Cort et Craig sont coincés au milieu de l’océan. Pendant ce temps, Eddie est le seul qui puisse aider une femme enceinte à accoucher.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Une question de vie ou de mort
programme.sub-title: Une question de vie ou de mort
programme.desc: Les conflits d’intérêts liés aux choix de carrière de Mitch et de son père deviennent encore plus graves lorsque Mitch apprend de terribles nouvelles à propos de son père.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Paradis interdit - 2e partie
programme.desc: Matt a été piqué par un poisson venimeux. Mitch et lui découvrent un village où une jeune femme leur offre son aide. Ils sont tous les trois poursuivis par son prétendant jaloux. Pendant ce temps, l’égoïsme de Logan met en péril sa relation avec Caroline.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Surfer n'est pas jouer
programme.desc: Le frère de Mitch lui rend une visite surprise, tandis que son fils convainc Hobie de surfer près d’une jetée condamnée. Au même moment, un vendeur local crée un scandale lorsque ses maillots de bains se désintègrent au contact de l’eau.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Vague de violence
programme.desc: April tente de sauver Manny de lui-même après un terrible accident survenu pendant un sauvetage. Neely se met dans le pétrin après s’en être prise à Alex, et elle essaye d’accuser Mitch à sa place.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: La plus belle de toutes
programme.desc: Une mystérieuse créature attaque les baigneurs et les sauveteurs partent à sa recherche. Pendant ce temps, un magazine sportif cherche une sauveteuse pour sa nouvelle couverture, et Neely et Caroline se battent pour la place.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Harcèlement
programme.desc: Hobie est très heureux de rencontrer Johnny Danger, mais lorsque Mitch apprend que l’idole de son fils est peu recommandable, il en vient à se questionner. Pendant ce temps, une nouvelle sauveteuse accuse Matt de harcèlement sexuel.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Le caisson de la dernière chance
programme.sub-title: Le caisson de la dernière chance
programme.desc: Mitch a une expérience extracorporelle alors qu’il essaye de secourir un plongeur sans aucun équipement. Il doit donc utiliser un caisson de décompression.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Fantôme d'amour - 2e partie
programme.desc: Naufragé en plein milieu de l’océan avec son frère inconscient, Mitch se bat pour le maintenir en vie pendant la nuit. CJ réunit un dauphin orphelin avec sa mère blessée, et Summer rencontre un fantôme fou d’amour.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Toutes voiles dehors
programme.desc: Stephanie recrute des surveillants de plage pour participer à une régate au cours de laquelle ils devront se mesurer à l'équipe de Santa Bay. Pendant ce temps, Mitch découvre que Joey a des grands-parents qui veulent s’occuper d’elle.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: La vie est un cadeau
programme.desc: Mitch demande Tracy en mariage mais leur bonheur est de courte durée car la jeune femme lui apprend qu’elle est atteinte d’une maladie incurable. L’équipe diminuée force Logan et Caroline à gérer seuls deux adolescents casse-cou.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: La baie du cauchemar - 2e partie
programme.desc: Alors que la « Créature de la Baie » coule un chalutier, Mitch et Devon soupçonnent un autre coupable derrière les attaques. Le Capitaine Thorne les aide à résoudre le mystère, et Shauni négocie avec son père.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Bon voyage
programme.desc: Alors que Lani se prépare à un shooting photo à bord d’un bateau de croisière en partance pour l’Alaska, Neely décide de retrouver son ex-mari qui y habite. Hobie, Mitch, et Cody se retrouvent par hasard sur le bateau des filles.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: C'est grave, docteur ?
programme.desc: Lorsque l’on diagnostique à un baigneur un virus mortel, le QG est mis en quarantaine. Mitch, April, Donna et JD sont enfermés avec un vendeur plutôt agaçant. Newman récupère le travail de JD.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Une équipe de choc - 1re partie
programme.desc: Après la mort de l’ex-femme d’un sauveteur de l’équipe, Mitch et les autres l’accompagnent en Australie, où il doit rencontrer son fils qu’il n’a jamais vu.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Rivière sans retour - 1re partie
programme.desc: Une mort mystérieuse pousse Mitch, Hobie, Eddie et Shauni à voyager jusqu’en Californie, le pays de l’or, pour vivre une expérience en eaux vives qu’ils n’oublieront jamais.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: 15 000 dollars sur un ski
programme.desc: Cort promet de rassembler 10 000 dollars pour une maison de retraite, mais il a besoin de l’aide de Mitch et Craig pour participer à une course de ski nautique pour gagner l’argent mis en jeu.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Le Retour d'Allison
programme.desc: Craig est jaloux de Mitch lorsqu’il renoue contact avec une ex-petite amie qu’ils ont en commun. Eddie s’offre une Mustang pour une bouchée de pain, et il réalise qu’il s’est fait avoir lorsqu’il est arrêté pour avoir conduit une voiture volée.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: L'épreuve
programme.desc: L’anniversaire de Mitch est la parfaite occasion pour lui de s’inscrire à une compétition sportive, malgré sa rencontre avec une femme plus jeune. Matt prend un travail de nuit pour économiser et s’acheter une nouvelle moto…

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Le nouveau locataire
programme.desc: Mitch engage le DJ Jenny McCarthy pour animer Beachblast, un tournoi télévisé, dans le but de lever des fonds pour ses Olympiades. Cody emménage chez CJ et Caroline après avoir été mis dehors.

programme.title: Alerte à Malibu: Une étoile est née
programme.desc: Des tremblements de terre mènent la vie dure aux sauveteurs.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Carta a papá noel
programme.desc: La amnesia de Ana está afectando a sus relaciones. Alexia continúa intentando librarse de ella. Los pequeños Hidalgo reescriben sus cartas para Papá Noel y los Reyes Magos al saber que Ana corre peligro. Serán unas Navidades inolvidables y decisivas.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Siempre nos quedará París
programme.desc: Ana le cuenta a Lucía sobre el inesperado regalo de Navidad, y un secreto, lo que se tornará en una pesadilla. Alexia y Ana tienen un enfrentamiento épico. Los niños quieren a Ana en sus vidas. Los conflictos están adquiriendo dimensiones profundas.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: El amor está en los pequeños detalles
programme.sub-title: El amor está en los pequeños detalles
programme.desc: Fernando pone a prueba el amor de Alexia. Ana, sin saberlo, se interpondrá. Carolina se preocupa por la situación laboral de su novio. Nando descuida sus obligaciones. Amalia conoce a la peculiar Blanca. Bruno se ha enamorado y Manuela tiene celos.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Tres deseos
programme.desc: Fernando toma una decisión crucial. Ana descubre los suspensos de Nando. Los niños quieren romper el hechizo y el compromiso de su padre con Alexia. Ana ayuda a Bruno a dar un gran paso. Amalia se interesa por un chico. Carolina discute con su novio.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Una noche loca
programme.desc: En casa de los Hidalgo se avecinan grandes cambios. Fernando ha roto con su pasado sentimental y desea iniciar una vida diferente. Ana parece dispuesta a olvidar a David, aunque aún le afecte. Un plan ajeno puede destruir definitivamente a la niñera.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Por fin
programme.desc: Entre Ana y Fernando se produce un encuentro decisivo. Alexia recibe un informe sorprendente sobre la extraña noche. Rosa espía a los Hidalgo. Manuela y Nando ayudan a Bruno. Carolina lamenta trabajar para su novio. Amalia vive una situación límite.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La gran sorpresa
programme.desc: Fernando decide dar un gran paso. El detective de Alexia hace un hallazgo sorprendente. Nando descubre que Fonty sale con Chiqui. Carolina no soporta trabajar para Natalia. Cristian muestra su verdadera cara. Un acontecimiento causará gran conmoción.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Una más en la familia
programme.desc: David reaparece con una adolescente y causa conmoción en la familia, altera los planes de Fernando y afecta a la vida de Manuela, Sharon y Bruno. Ana está confusa, sobre todo al descubrir el motivo de su marcha. Alexia quiere hacer una revelación.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Las cosas han cambiado
programme.desc: Los hermanos compiten por el amor de Ana. Alexia continúa sus malvadas maquinaciones. Nando hace un descubrimiento preocupante. Carolina toma una decisión importante. Amalia se venga de Cristian. Bruno lucha por su relación. Manuela recupera la ilusión.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: El triunfo de Alexia
programme.desc: Ana sigue sometida a la presión de los hermanos Hidalgo. Andrea sufre una recaída, pero encuentra un aliado. Bruno se implica más en la vida de Sharon. Manuela sospecha que Alexia ha llegado demasiado lejos. Ana toma una valiente y difícil decisión.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Noche de ronda
programme.desc: Fernando necesita reevaluar sus sentimientos. Ana se siente en un callejón sin salida. David quiere aprovecharse de la situación. Manuela y los pequeños aún sospechan que hay un complot y actúan. La verdad sobre el origen de la crisis se va revelar.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La reacción de Fernando
programme.desc: Carolina contraataca a Jorge quedando con un exnovio. Nando pide ayuda a Fonty por sus problemas con Montse. Bruno asimila su hallazgo sobre Sharon. Los pequeños intentan ayudar a Ana yendo demasiado lejos. La conmoción está a punto de sacudir sus vidas.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La venganza
programme.desc: La familia sigue en shock por las nuevas de Fernando y Alexia, que tiene una estrategia contra el servicio. Ana y ella se enfrentan. David le cuenta a Fernando lo que ocurrió con Ana. Los niños no aceptan la nueva situación y quieren boicotearla.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La reina de las nieves
programme.desc: Fernando se ha tornado frío. Bruno asume más responsabilidades con Sharon, no sin problemas. Andrea está ilusionada por su amistad con Fonty, que malinterpreta su actitud. Debido al problema de Lucía, los niños desencadenarán sucesos importantes.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La decisión
programme.desc: Alexia continúa con su destructivo plan. Ana aguanta su trato vejatorio por amor a los niños. Bruno y Sharon dan un gran paso en su relación. Alexia cree que los niños conspiran contra ella. Gracias a Andrea se encontrará en una situación límite.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Las últimas balas
programme.desc: Fernando descubre los planes de Alexia para sus hijos, que maneja la situación. Ana se apoya en David, que le oculta cosas. Bruno pasa por una crisis. Los niños provocan un enorme malentendido en el colegio. El caos gobierna la casa de los Hidalgo.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La oportunidad de david
programme.desc: Un dramático rumor tiene consecuencias insospechadas. Ana decide dar un paso que quizá cambie su vida radicalmente. Bruno toma una decisión arriesgada. Fonty descubre los sentimientos de Andrea. Al regreso de Fernando, Ana hará un hallazgo crucial.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Entre la espada y la pared
programme.sub-title: Entre la espada y la pared
programme.desc: Fernando toma una decisión. Alexia y su madre urden otra estrategia contra Ana. Fernando y David quieren ayudar, pero supondría un gran sacrificio personal y profesional para Fernando que Ana no acepta y toma una dolorosa decisión. Bruno desaparece.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: El gran día
programme.desc: Ana y David se preparan para su gran día. Entre los hermanos hay tensión. Sharon quiere sorprender a Ana, aunque la sorpresa será inesperada. Andrea reconsidera la relación con su padre. Todos se cuestionan lo que va a suceder tras un imprevisto suceso.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La boda de ana
programme.desc: Tras las revelaciones de David todo termina por volver a la normalidad. A Fernando solo le queda recordarle a Ana sus sentimientos y esperar. Carolina tiene que lidiar con sus dos exnovios. Andrea sigue disgustada con su padre, pero tiene un plan.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: La resaca
programme.desc: La “noche de bodas” no fue ideal por lo ocurrido con Fernando. ¿Descubrirá Ana los motivos de David para casarse? La salud de Ana se resiente. Los pequeños planean encontrar pareja a su padre. Ana le hace una confesión a Andrea que no quedará ahí.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: El secreto mejor guardado
programme.desc: Todos van averiguando lo que le pasa a Ana. Fernando habla con David para contárselo, pensando en la felicidad de Ana. ¿Conocerá Manuela al hombre que buscaba? Celia está cambiando y se aleja de sus hermanos pequeños. Carolina está feliz con Jorge.

programme.title: Ana y los 7: Una pregunta sin respuesta
programme.desc: Fernando tiene que actuar para disuadir a Ana de su decisión radical. La aventura de Manuela la decepcionará. Nando afronta la Selectividad inseguro. Lucía quiere un novio, pero los gemelos se oponen. Ana le hace a Sharon una revelación sensacional.

programme.desc: Wiederholt wird die Andromeda angegriffen, obwohl sie mehrere Slipstream-Sprünge gemacht hat und dadurch stetig ihre Position ändert. Captain Hunt vermutet, dass sich ein Maulwurf an Bord befindet. Er analysiert verschiedene Datenaufnahmen.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade und Harper sind mit dem Sternenkreuzer Eureka Maru unterwegs, als sie von Templern angegriffen und gefangen genommen werden. Der Herrscher der Templer zwingt Harper, seinem Volk bei einem Brückenbau zu helfen.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Eine Spionin des Commonwealth wird auf die Andromeda geschickt: die attraktive Indira. Sie informiert Dylan, dass die Kommandeurin der Commonwealth-Flotte, Tri-Jema, bereit sei, Dylans Namen zu rehabilitieren.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Eine Fehlprogrammierung von Harper führt dazu, dass Rommie plötzlich ein Gefühlschaos erleidet. Ausgerechnet in dem Moment, wo sie von Magogs angegriffen werden, verweigert sich Rommie der Befehle der Andromeda-Crew.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Das Team der Andromeda ist in Gefahr: Auf der Suche nach einer geheimen Waffe gegen den gefährlichen Abyss gelangen sie in eine mysteriöse Bibliothek. Was sie nicht wissen: Auch die Geister des Abyss' sind dort, um ihren Krieg vorzubereiten.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Die Andromeda fliegt zu den Arkology, einer friedlich gesinnten Kolonie. Doch dann funkt ihnen ein Weltenschiff der Magog dazwischen, das die Andromeda angreifen will. Die Crew stellt fest, dass sie mit friedlichen Mitteln nichts ausrichten können.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan erwacht wieder auf Seefra-1 nach der "Route der Zeitalter". Hier leben Wesen, die wenig Ahnung von Technologie haben und deshalb ihrem System nicht entfliehen können. Und dann trifft Dylan dort auf seinen früheren Offizier Rhade.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan und Rhade empfangen ein Monat altes Notsignal von Beka, das bislang offenbar noch niemand bemerkt hat. Als sie dem Signal folgen, stoßen sie auf die Andromeda, die funktionsuntüchtig im Weltraum treibt. Doch sie sind nicht die Ersten.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Aus der Lieblingsbar von Dylan, Beka und Rhade wird ein Kunstwerk gestohlen. Angsthormone haben die Besucher außer Gefecht gesetzt. Hinter dem Raub steckt eine gemeine Verbrecherin. Und Harper ist ihr Handlanger! Er reagiert panisch.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Doyle soll kein Mensch sein, sondern ein Androide. Alpträume und Erinnerungen an ein Leben auf der Andromeda bedrängen sie. Ein Fremder, der sich bei einem Raubüberfall vor sie und Harper stellt, kann scheinbar Licht in die Angelegenheit bringen.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Beka und Dylan geraten auf Seefra-1 in einen Hinterhalt von Gangstern. Während des Kampfes hat Beka eine ausgesprochen merkwürdige Vision: Virgil Vox, ein Radio-DJ, widmet ihr ein Lied und spricht von einem Geheimnis, welches das Lied umgibt.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Dylan trifft in einer Bar Celine, eine Bekannte aus alten Zeiten, die offenbar in einer Zeitschleife gefangen ist. Der Grund dafür wird bald klar: Gemeinsam mit anderen vedranischen Forschern führte sie in einem geheimen Labor Experimente durch.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Um endlich das Seefra-System verlassen und die Andromeda reparieren zu können, benötigt die Besatzung der Andromeda gewisse Kristalle, die in einem Bergwerk abgebaut werden. Dylan und Rhade schleichen sich in die Mine ein.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Nach einer Bemerkung von Rhade verlässt Trance aufgebracht die Andromeda. Sie verirrt sich in den unterirdischen Tunneln von Seefra 1. Im Gewirr der Gänge trifft sie auf ein altes vedranisches Geheimnis und dessen Wächter.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Ein alter Mann stirbt, während er mit Harper wegen eines Artefakts verhandelt. Daraufhin taucht ein geheimnisvoller Fremder auf und beschuldigt die Andromeda-Crew für dessen Tod mitverantwortlich zu sein. Er quält sie mit Visionen.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Die Andromeda-Crew verteidigt ein Flüchtlingslager auf Seefra-5 gegen die Miliz eines Warlords. Da erscheint plötzlich Hohne, ein totgeglaubter Freund von Harper, auf der Brücke der Andromeda. Offenbar starb er nicht drei Jahre zuvor im Slipstream.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Bekas neuer Freund Peter sorgt auf der Andromeda für jede Menge Ärger. Doch dass er nicht nur merkwürdig, sondern ausgesprochen gefährlich ist, merkt die Crew beinahe zu spät: Peter entführt Beka und entnimmt ihr eine DNS-Probe.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Beka und Rhade sind auf der Suche nach einem Schatz. In einem alten vedranischen Ausbildungslager geraten die beiden in eine Falle und werden eingeschlossen. Trance lernt unterdessen in einem Zirkus auf Seefra-2 den rätselhaften Ione kennen.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Trances Sonne droht das komplette Seefra-System zu vernichten. Die einzige Rettung finden Harper und Dylan in Vedranischen Blaupausen, die die Funktionsweise eines Abwehrsystems zeigen. Alle Planeten müssen dazu explodieren.

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Während die vedranische Sonne immer näher kommt, sucht Harper nach einer Lösung, um das Seefra-System zu retten. Dylan vergewissert sich, ob Harper mit der Arbeit vorankommt. Dabei bemerkt er nicht, dass sich eine fremde Präsenz an Bord befindet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Il cuore del viaggio (Parte 1)
programme.desc: L'equipaggio lascia finalmente il sistema Seefra e scopre che Dylan è l'ultimo Paradine.

programme.title: Andromeda: Il cuore del viaggio (Parte 2)
programme.desc: Nell’ultimo episodio della serie, la battaglia finale per salvare il Nuovo Commonwealth del Sistema ha inizio.

programme.title: Andromeda: Sotto la notte
programme.desc: Dopo essere stato abbandonato vicino ad un buco nero, il capitano Dylan Hunt viene ritrovata da una nave di salvataggio mercenaria e scopre di essere rimasto ibernato per 300 anni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una fiamma di dichiarazione
programme.desc: Dylan protegge l'Andromeda dai mercenari mentre Beka comincia a chiedersi se stanno combattendo la fazione sbagliata.

programme.title: Andromeda: Perdere il lampo fatidico
programme.desc: Dylan trova una stazione spaziale popolata da bambini che credono che lui sia per lì per portare la pace e uccidere i loro nemici.

programme.title: Andromeda: D meno zero
programme.desc: L'equipaggio dell’Andromeda sta ancora imparando come lavorare insieme mentre vengono attaccati dai Risolutori.

programme.title: Andromeda: Doppia elica
programme.desc: L'Andromeda è coinvolta in una faida tra un pianeta Than e una colonia nietzscheana.

programme.title: Andromeda: Angelo oscuro, demone luminoso
programme.desc: Uno slipstream catapulta l'Andromeda indietro nel tempo a poco prima della caduta del Commonwealth. L'equipaggio deve intervenire per proteggere la storia.

programme.title: Andromeda: I legami che accecano
programme.desc: Dopo aver risposto a una chiamata di soccorso, l'equipaggio raccoglie il fratello di Beka, ora un Wayista, e il suo amico.

programme.title: Andromeda: Le sponde del Lete
programme.desc: Grazie a un buco nero Dylan riesce a comunicare con la sua ex compagna, 300 anni fa.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una rosa nelle ceneri
programme.desc: Dylan è prigioniero su un pianeta-prigione e deve trovare una via di fuga mentre l’equipaggio organizza il suo salvataggio.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tutto l'oceano del grande Nettuno
programme.desc: I Castaliani salgono a bordo dell'Andromeda per ultimare la costituzione del Nuovo Commonwealth. Quando il loro leader viene trovato morto, tutti i sospetti ricadono su Tyr.

programme.title: Andromeda: Le perle che erano i suoi occhi
programme.sub-title: Le perle che erano i suoi occhi
programme.desc: Beka viene a sapere che l'ex socio in affari di suo padre è coinvolto nello spaccio di una droga che da forte dipendenza chiamata Flash.

programme.title: Andromeda: La matematica delle lacrime
programme.desc: L'Andromeda scopre la sua nave sorella, la Pax Magellanic. L'equipaggio a bordo della Pax ha 300 anni... ma non è invecchiato di un giorno.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musica di un tamburo distante
programme.desc: Tyr fa un atterraggio di fortuna con l'Eureka Maru su un pianeta nietzscheano e perde la memoria. Deve ricordarsi di quello che stava facendo prima che i Nietzscheani scoprano lui e la sua cassa di merci rubate.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Dopo aver ricevuto il dono della conoscenza da un Perseide morente, Harper scopre che il Perseide era ricercato da un cacciatore di taglie, il quale ora ha spostato la sua attenzione su Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Prospettiva forzata
programme.desc: Dylan viene arrestato per aver assassinato un dittatore 300 anni fa.

programme.title: Andromeda: La somma delle parti
programme.desc: L’Andromeda viene affondata da un drone del Consenso delle Parti, una mitica società meccanica. Nonostante si dimostri inizialmente amichevole, il drone tenta di costringere la nave a unirsi al Consenso.

programme.title: Andromeda: Paura e disgusto nella Via Lattea
programme.sub-title: Paura e disgusto nella Via Lattea
programme.desc: Gerentex è tornato e chiede a Trance e Harper di aiutarlo nel suo nuovo piano: trovare Tarn-Vedra.

programme.title: Andromeda: Abbandonarsi al destino
programme.desc: Dylan e Rev Bem aiutano una società pacifica a combattere contro chi li vorrebbe schiavi. Ma devono fare attenzione: se Dylan insegna loro a uccidere, anche i figli che nasceranno sapranno uccidere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Il miele offerto
programme.desc: Dylan tenta di portare la pace tra due fazioni avversarie di Nietzscheani scortando la principessa di un gruppo al matrimonio organizzato con il principe dell'altro.

programme.title: Andromeda: Attraversato dalle stelle
programme.desc: L'avatar di Rommie s’innamora di quello che si rivela essere l'avatar di una nave da guerra di nome Gabriel. Gabriel cerca d’infettare Rommie con un virus capace di trasmettere i suoi piani alla nave da guerra.

programme.title: Andromeda: Fa una bella luce
programme.desc: Beka conduce l'Andromeda a Tarn-Vedra, ma rimanere a lungo nello slipstream ha degli effetti collaterali. Beka inizia a usare Flash per combatterli e ne diventa presto dipendente.

programme.title: Andromeda: È ora di fare vista finalmente
programme.sub-title: È ora di fare vista finalmente
programme.desc: Una vecchia memoria dell'Andromeda viene accidentalmente attivata, lanciando la nave in missione. Dylan e l'equipaggio non sanno come annullare il comando.

programme.title: Andromeda: Il vortice che si allarga
programme.desc: Dylan e Rommie devono salvare Tyr, Harper e Rev dal mondo dei Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Strategie di uscita
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev e Tyr fanno un brusco atterraggio dopo essere scappati da una banda di Nietzscheani, ma dovranno presto affrontare una nuova minaccia: Rev ha fame.

programme.title: Andromeda: Come incastrare un bugiardo
programme.desc: L'equipaggio deve rubare un gioiello che è al centro di una faida tra un proprietario di Drift e il Than. Beka s’innamora di un capo della sicurezza con un passato da ladro.

programme.title: Andromeda: Spietato come il sole
programme.desc: L’Andromeda risponde a una chiamata di soccorso mentre una nave da carico viene attaccata.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ultima chiamata per il martello rotto
programme.sub-title: Ultima chiamata per il martello rotto
programme.desc: L'equipaggio è alla ricerca di un ex capo del Commonwealth latitante.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tutto troppo umano
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka e Trance vanno con Rommie alla scoperta di un'arma inventata su un pianeta che non crede nell'AI.

programme.title: Andromeda: Una Salus Victus
programme.desc: L’Andromeda ha il compito di scortare le navi mediche attraverso lo spazio Drago-Kazov.

programme.title: Andromeda: Incendi domestici
programme.desc: Un pianeta abitato da superstiti del Commonwealth guidato dall'ex compagna di Dylan viene invitato a entrare a far parte del Nuovo Commonwealth. Ma sembra che i Magog stiano giocando sporco quando il pianeta vota contro l’unione.
