programme.title: Designing the Hebrides
programme.desc: Banjo's brought in to help two small businesses who survive by selling their produce via honesty boxes. Jamie and Mary live on the Isle of Mull. Jamie works full time catching lobsters, and Mary looks after their three children but also runs a small sandwich shop. Too busy to open the shop full time, they also sell their produce in an honesty box. They want Banjo’s help to make their box stand out and attract visitors. The other honesty box is in South Uist, in the Outer Hebrides. Donna works as a carer by day but also has a side hustle making ice cream. She currently runs her honesty box out of an old livestock trailer and wants Banjo to help her build something more imaginative and fun. Can his ambitious honesty boxes stand out in the crowd and please the clients?

programme.title: Designing the Hebrides
programme.desc: Artist Mike and his teacher wife Kate moved to Iona 20 years ago. They now run Iona Wool, which sells ethical local wool products. Their shop is functional but could do with some Banjo design magic. The beautiful colours of their stock mean that they don’t want much colour, which is a challenge for Banjo, whose designs are often dark and richly coloured. Banjo comes up with a modern Hebridean design idea which he hopes will keep selling the gorgeous woollens but also warm up the shop with some fun design features. Banjo heads to Glasgow to his favourite salvage shop and buys dozens of bobbins from old wool mills to help with his design. His trusty team of local tradespeople help him realise his design vision. Meanwhile, Lisa makes woollen lampshades, and Eoghan builds a woven timber wall to hide a changing room. With little time and only £6,000, will Banjo’s shop transformation hit the mark?

programme.title: Two Doors Down
programme.desc: Disaster following a row with Sophie means that Christine has to stay over at Eric and Beth's. Beth isn't impressed with the new makeover Eric has done of Ian's old room. Cathy and Colin have a bust-up when she discovers that Colin has been using his laptop for something quite unrelated to work.

programme.title: The Chief
programme.desc: The Chief is made aware of a potential newspaper scoop featuring a leaked recording that could sink his whole career. His paranoia soon becomes all-consuming, and he suspects those around him in the force - even his own family - of betrayal. These explosive revelations threaten to eclipse his revolutionary new police work policy, where he redefines the very nature of crime. As his relationship with government, press and the public deteriorates, will he be forced to redefine the very nature of the Chief?

programme.title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
programme.desc: Behind the billion-pound success of OnlyFans lies a hidden ecosystem of exploitation. A BBC Current Affairs investigation uncovers allegations of exploitation, coercion and violence committed by some of the hundreds of agents who manage many of the platform’s creators as well as the potential for modern slavery. Through survivor testimony, undercover access to a managers’ chat forum and expert legal analysis, the film exposes an industry where young women are trapped, threatened and profited from - raising urgent questions about accountability at the heart of one of Britain's most lucrative tech companies.

programme.title: This Country
programme.desc: It is the most important day of the year for Kerry - the annual steam fair. And as a bonus, this year it falls on her birthday, and Kurtan has organised her a surprise present. programme.title: This Country
programme.desc: Family loyalty is vital in rural communities, and Kerry's lifelong ambition has been to work with her father, Martin. She is therefore overjoyed when he asks her to help him store some wares in a lock-up garage. A job at the local bowls club gives Kurtan a new sense of purpose, but when Kerry entangles Kurtan in her new venture, things start to unravel, and the Mucklowe family loyalties are put to the test.

programme.title: My Mate's a Bad Date
programme.desc: Georgie’s best mate Vicky is the ultimate dating ice queen. Vicky is super-picky, has a long list of unrealistic criteria for her perfect match, dumps guys for using the wrong emojis, analyses everything they do and walks out of 60 per cent of her dates. Tired of hearing about Vicky’s first date failures and delivering advice that gets ignored, Georgie calls on sex and relationships expert Oloni for an urgent intervention. Oloni wants Vicky to see where it's all going wrong, so she dishes out some cold, hard truths as she unpacks Vicky’s dating history and shows her some frank and honest video feedback from friends, family and even exes, to prove to Vicky that her bad dating behaviour needs a serious reboot. Oloni has to pull out all the stops to melt this ice queen as she sets Vicky up on a series of first dates that will challenge her behaviour and make her a better dater. Under the watchful eye of Oloni and Georgie, is Vicky ready for a change, will she give the guys a chance, be nice and let her guard down, or will she retain her ice queen crown?

And once the new Longhorns are in place, it's time for a special celebration meal with beef at its very heart.

programme.title: Nadiya’s Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya shares some deliciously simple family bakes, from daughter Maryam’s ultimate jam and chocolate flapjacks to an easy, oven-baked chilli topped with crunchy tortillas.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Elinor and Marianne Dashwood are thrown into sudden hardship on the death of their father as their brother, John, inherits his fortune. In straitened circumstances, they are taken in by a kindly cousin, but the lack of fortune affects the marriageability of both the practical Elinor and the romantic Marianne.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Members of the public bring their antiques to be viewed and valued.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: Four famous faces paired with a friend or a loved one must tackle the most formidable race yet - traversing the ancient jungles and indigenous heartlands of Borneo to the southern tip of Australia.

programme.title: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: 1940. Britain fears an impending German invasion. Goering is confident his Luftwaffe will pave the way for success. It falls to brave squadrons of fighter pilots to fend off the attack from the air.

programme.title: Serie A
programme.desc: Live coverage of AC Milan v Inter Milan in the Italian Serie A.

programme.title: True North
programme.desc: In Derry-Londonderry, a once deeply divided city comes together to share a collective fascination with ghosts, ghouls and the stuff of nightmares. In 1985, at the height of The Troubles, a Halloween-themed fancy-dress party in a local pub did something remarkable: it united a divided community. Forty years later, the small party that started as a fun distraction has grown into Europe’s largest Halloween festival, leaving the entire city spellbound. We follow the ordinary people behind the extraordinary spectacle as they create and build the street theatre, costumes and art that bring Derry Halloween to life. But this year isn’t without its own mischief and mayhem, from gale-force winds and structural collapses to wrangling a 50-metre snake. Bringing together schools, youth clubs, dance troupes, workshops, costume makers and drumming bands, this is the story of a diverse city, young and old, dancing together in the streets, bound by a shared tradition, a fierce community spirit and an obsession with the dark arts of Halloween!

programme.title: QI
programme.desc: Sandi takes a look at tubes and tubas in a totally tubular show with Bridget Christie, Sara Pascoe, Deborah Frances White and Alan Davies.

programme.title: Oasis – Live at Manchester City Stadium
programme.desc: Oasis, one of the world's biggest touring bands pulls out all the stops during their 2005 world tour. Following the release of a sixth studio album, they return to their hometown of Manchester for a triumphant concert at the City of Manchester Stadium. The performance includes Lyla, Songbird, The Importance of Being Idle, Live Forever, Don’t Look Back in Anger, Cigarettes and Alcohol, Rock 'n' Roll Star and a raucous version of The Who’s classic anthem My Generation.

programme.title: Oasis - Right Here, Right Now
programme.desc: First broadcast in 1997, this documentary gives the band's account of their previous year. Featuring exclusive performances and detailed interviews with the Gallaghers.

programme.title: No Bears
programme.desc: A dissident film-maker who is trying to direct a movie in Turkey while being forced to remain in a nearby Iranian border town finds himself embroiled in a local scandal.

During the peak of a cyclone known as Storm Amy, Bridlington’s lifeboat is tasked to a Dutch trawler that has lost power 13 miles off the Yorkshire coast. In Ireland, an urgent call comes in to the Crosshaven crew from a yacht taking part in a local race; on board, an elderly sailor is reported to have broken his leg. The Calshot crew face a tense search in thick fog for a motorboat with engine failure - somewhere in the busy shipping lanes of the Solent. And reports of a submerged car in the Thames put the Chiswick crew on red alert.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: After discovering that the person responsible for Ricardo’s death is someone close to him, Michael scrambles for a way to protect them from the consequences – without jeopardising Diana.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: In this year’s Countryfile Ramble for BBC Children in Need, Matt Baker, Anita Rani, Margherita Taylor, Joe Crowley and John Craven lace up their walking boots to meet inspirational young people whose lives have been transformed through support from BBC Children in Need. The ramble is returning for its 12th year, set against the stunning backdrop of the Peak District. The presenters walk alongside five remarkable young people who have faced significant challenges, hearing first-hand how BBC Children in Need-funded projects have helped them build confidence, resilience and hope for the future.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie is in Aberdeenshire, visiting Scotland’s first inclusive farm, built by a blind farmer who is determined to make agriculture accessible for all. Arlene sails to Jura to see how the locals cope with the huge deer population and find new outlets for venison. Anne discovers how the shortage of affordable rural housing is being tackled in the Highlands. And Shahbaz is on the shores of Loch Linnhe near Fort William to see the stranded fishing boat that has become a local landmark.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek is island-hopping in this round-up of his favourite Welsh island walks. He goes wild in west Wales as he sails to Skomer Island – a national nature reserve of international importance due to its seabirds - where he gets a close-up view of the puffins, razorbills and guillemots before staying up late to see the Manx shearwater. Next, Derek goes to Flat Holm Island, where he braves a huge colony of seagulls and discovers more about the island's past, including some Victorian gun placements. Lastly, Derek heads up north to Wales's largest island, Anglesey, where he visits another tiny island with a secluded chapel, an unexpected motor racing track, a neolithic burial chamber and a sauna on a beach.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt dishes up a feast of food from the Saturday Kitchen archives to whet the appetite for the week ahead. The Hairy Bikers bring comfort food bang up to date with sticky Szechuan lamb, stuffed into pillowy soft bao buns, with a fresh hit of pickled carrots, spring onion and herbs – cosy comfort with a fragrant Asian twist! Meera Sodha introduces a taste of Sri Lanka to the studio as she continues the comfort theme with her warming lentil and coconut dal with crispy mustard kale. Jeremy Lee brings his effervescent charm and wit to the kitchen whilst giving an underused cut of meat its chance in the spotlight. He makes a rich steamed kid pudding that melts in the mouth. Mary McCartney celebrates Bonfire Night with her flavour-packed smoky dogs, while Carmen O’Neal and Idris Elba team up to serve a masterclass in brandy. And queen of puddings Nigella Lawson tucks into either her food heaven, scallops, or her food hell, candied fruit. Meanwhile, Rick Stein explores the New Forest's bounty of produce, and the Hairy Bikers make a Menorcan dish in the Mediterranean Sea.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Sitting between Germany and France, Alsace is frontier land with a cuisine to match. In Strasbourg, Eva stops off at Brasserie Le Tigre for a beer (brassier means ‘to brew’) and a deliciously creamy tarte flambee. Then there's a trip to guide Coralie Andt’s restaurant, known as a winstub, where French wines can be enjoyed with plenty of cheese and sausage – as well as more sausage with sauerkraut cooked in white Riesling wine. With French tarts in a brasserie that serves German-style beer, and German sausage in a winstub serving French white wine, Alsace is defined by its competing national influences.

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever
programme.desc: With Britain more obsessed with baking than ever, actress and cake expert Jane Asher brings together a selection of recipes from the nation's favourite television chefs, for Best Bakes Ever. Each episode gives baking fans another chance to experience classic dishes from the likes of the James Martin, Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, the Hairy Bikers, Raymond Blanc, Nigella Lawson, Tom Kerridge, Lorraine Pascale and Rachel Khoo. There's added insight and appreciation from Jane herself too. Whether its cakes, pies, puddings or main courses - this greatest hits of baking is a must for anyone with a need to knead, and should help inspire even more of us to start getting creative in the kitchen.

programme.title: I Was Monty's Double
programme.desc: World War II drama. A low-ranking officer who resembles General Montgomery is recruited to play his double in an elaborate plan to trick the Nazis.

programme.title: Women's Super League
programme.desc: Women's Super League action as Charlton Athletic face Chelsea.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin introduces a collection of the best finds from the show's travels to Lulworth Castle in Dorset, Chiddingstone Castle in Kent, and Wrest Park in Bedfordshire. The antiques experts include Catherine Southon, Christina Trevanion, Adam Partridge, Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, with items ranging from a cloisonne vase to an astonishing collection of First World War slides. Paul also finds out more about the ancient art of shipbuilding at Buckler's Hard in Hampshire.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: For a live demonstration of terroir, Eva heads to Domaine Dujac, home of the current most-wanted Burgundy wine. Standing on one side of a road, owner Jeremy Seysses points to a parcel of grand cru (the very best) of Clos de la Roche. On the other side is a premier cru (the next best) - a Gevrey-Chambertin Combottes. Back at the winery, Eva tucks into beef cheeks bathed in Domaine Dujac for a classic boeuf bourguignon lunch. Despite the grapes being grown just a few metres away, these reds are a class apart.

programme.title: Wild Horses, the Rockies and Me
programme.desc: Gordon Buchanan heads to the Rocky Mountains in search of wild horses. Finding two stallions battling over a herd, Gordon immerses himself in their world, hoping to win their trust.

programme.title: BBC Young Musician
programme.desc: Who will be crowned the winner? Three virtuosic performers vie for the coveted title in a thrilling concert at Bristol Beacon. Presented by Petroc Trelawny.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob are back in Norfolk - a bittersweet return, as this was the very first location where Ted joined them. They both reminisce about Ted and raise a cup in his memory - although Ted would have preferred a biscuit. They head to some prime Norfolk lakes, hoping to catch a bream. It’s been well documented that Bob is not a fan of the bream, but will a big catch make him change his tune? It's Paul and Bob's birthday week, and they consider whether they may celebrate any further milestones or simply let them pass. Bob ends up throwing a surprise 70s-themed birthday party for Paul on the roof of the Blickling Estate, once owned by the Boleyn family.

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Irish film star Chris O'Dowd joins Bill Murray and his friend Tom Coyne for a lively round of golf, with enthusiasm occasionally outstripping ability. Away from the fairways, a traditional rambling house takes Bill outside his comfort zone as he explores Ireland's rich storytelling traditions. Later, in a packed Irish pub, the music starts – and staying on the sidelines proves impossible.

programme.title: Later... with Jools Holland
programme.desc: Jools welcomes Skepta, Jordan Rakei, Bloc Party, Johnny and Lillie Flynn, corto.alto and Rita Wilson.

programme.title: Walk the Line
programme.desc: The story of the legendary country artist Johnny Cash, from his early days on an Arkansas cotton farm to his rise to fame with Sun Records and his long association with singer June Carter, later to become his wife.

programme.title: Ellie & Natasia
programme.desc: A routine driving lesson takes a bizarre, surreal turn; a game show called Find the Snakes is destined to sweep the nation; contemporary politicians are introduced to a literal public arena; vape sommeliers treat e-liquid profiles with the gravity of a fine Bordeaux; two ultra-wealthy girls are determined to get exactly what they want; and two restaurant-goers take their love of food to an intense extreme. Featuring an appearance from Asim Chaudry.

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Following this week’s Labour Budget, Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Warwick. On the panel are chief secretary to the treasury, Labour’s Emma Reynolds MP; Conservative James Cartlidge MP; Liberal Democrat Daisy Cooper MP; Reform UK’s Zia Yusuf; and podcaster and author Alastair Campbell. They debate the Budget, Brexit and debt from student loans.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Les Dennis, Jenny Eclair, Owain Wyn Evans and Lauren Patel take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player?

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: In the tropical seas, year-round sunshine has created the perfect conditions for the ocean’s richest habitats to flourish, but survival takes remarkable and surprising ingenuity.

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of Sunday’s only Premier League game as Liverpool take on champions Arsenal at Anfield. Kelly Cates is joined by Micah Richards and Danny Murphy.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The big political issues of the day.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 30 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Comedian Jason Manford hosts an exciting, fast-paced quiz show, where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle The Answer Run down towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face The Final Run and win the chance to take home their cash prize. Who will swipe their way to victory?

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher and Edith Bowman explore Cockermouth’s food festival, meeting passionate food producers and getting tips on homemade pitta bread from a MasterChef winner. Cookery writer Michaela Chiappa discovers how seaweed is being harvested for food, and chef Julie Lin gets the low down on low-fat, semi-skimmed and full-fat milk. Chef Suzie Lee reveals how top chefs are getting creative as they reduce food waste.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo begins a series of coastal railway journeys around the British Isles, starting in Siccar Point, the site of an extraordinary 18th-century discovery, and finishing at Holyrood House.

programme.title: Secrets of the Aquarium
programme.desc: Marcus and Emma head to the Maldives on a rescue mission for an injured turtle. Back in Plymouth, Ian trains Zeus the zebra shark using a toy boat, and Andrew collects fresh seaweed for Larry the lobster.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head to Ipswich, where among the treasures they find are a duke's chamber pot now used to drink champagne from, one of the earliest record players, and a 50p find on a white elephant stall which turns out to be worth much more.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Today Flog It! comes from Glemham Hall in the Suffolk countryside. Antiques experts James Lewis and David Fletcher find a selection of antiques and collectibles to take to auction. There’s a Flog It first when James uncovers a copy of a Raphael painting saved by a Jewish professor who fled Hitler’s regime, and David Fletcher spots a rare flintlock pistol. Paul Martin visits a Cold War airbase to find out what life was like for American airmen based in the UK.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player?

programme.title: Strictly - It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor kicks off the week by chatting to the latest couple to be eliminated from the competition. Also, Friday’s all-star panel return to look back at the weekend’s spooky performances.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Jonathan Head reports from Thailand, where recent flooding has highlighted the growing challenges facing Bangkok. As climate change brings rising seas and more extreme weather across South East Asia, we examine why the Thai capital is among the region's most vulnerable cities. Plus: BBC Eye investigates the shadow war being fought inside Russia, speaking to two Russian men who claim to have secretly worked for Ukraine's intelligence services. Through rare first-hand accounts, we explore a clandestine world of covert operations, sabotage and espionage targeting military personnel and infrastructure far from the battlefield.

programme.title: Mastermind
programme.desc: Four more contenders take to the black chair under the spotlight and the ticking clock to answer questions on their specialist subjects and general knowledge. Clive Myrie asks the questions, which are on the Swallows and Amazons novels of Arthur Ransome, the American artist Jean-Michel Basquiat, the television series Succession and the SAS commander Blair Mayne.

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far – the vital extra ingredients are logic and lateral thinking. It’s a knockout round, and only one of the two returning teams can go through after trying to establish what connects such apparently random clues as Bradypus tridactylus, ‘Sunflower Seeds’ artist, Anguilla and Grok.

programme.title: University Challenge
programme.desc: The second round of the competition begins. Two teams of students go head-to-head for a place in the quarter-finals. Amol Rajan asks the questions.

programme.title: Escaping Idi Amin
programme.desc: In September 1972, one month after dictator Idi Amin announces his plan to expel all Ugandan Asians from the country, 80,000 people are making plans to flee, in fear for their lives. Maz and Bharti head for the capital Kampala, where hundreds gather, desperate to find out whether their British passports will be enough to escape to Britain. As the deadline approaches, Harminder’s father escapes arrest and schoolboy Paresh hides during overnight curfews while gunfire echoes across the city. Britain is divided. Controversial politician Enoch Powell rallies those who say the Ugandan Asians have no right to come, a newspaper poll finds just six per cent of the public want them here, and some councils try to steer new arrivals away from their cities. In Uganda, Amin refuses to negotiate – stepping up the pressure on those stuck in the country.

programme.title: Ceolta
programme.desc: Léirítear traidisiún ársa an cheoil i gCo. Thír Eoghain in Tomney’s Bar ar an Mhaigh san eagrán seo. Is iad Cliona Hagan, North x North West, Joe McVeigh, agus Pinsleep aoicheoltóirí na hoíche, agus tá meascán mearaí stíleanna acu uilig - fuaimeanna traidisiúnta na hÉireann, lorg an cheol tíre agus an ceol comhaimseartha fosta. The musical traditions of Co. Tyrone are highlighted in Tomney’s Bar in Moy. The featured artists - Cliona Hagan, North x North West, Joe McVeigh and Pinsleep - blend traditional Irish sounds with country, folk and contemporary elements.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day. With Victoria Derbyshire.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: A brutal murder in an Inverness home sparks a manhunt for two violent suspects. Detectives recover crucial evidence beside a canal and track down CCTV, but the case takes a strange turn when they begin to doubt their main eyewitness. On Lewis, police face a stand-off with a camper van driver who insists the law doesn’t apply to her. And in the Cairngorms, an upturned canoe triggers a search for a missing man.

programme.title: Blue Lights
programme.desc: Sandra enlists help to expose Gerry’s secrets, while Tommy and Shane inch closer to exposing the drug pipeline.

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: Lee finds an undiscovered Banksy and attempts to steal the artwork in a foolhardy quest for fame and fortune. When he is collared by a security guard, however, he panics and hints that he might be Banksy to get away. Now, he finds himself at the centre of a blackmail plot.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Flutter is sent to the ‘naughty berg’ as punishment when he falls foul of an old Piri rule. But when the others start telling tales, he’s not the only one to be banished.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Whilst Dad searches for a faulty wire, Cosima and Big Lizard play tag in the ship and accidentally break Big Lizard's bath bed! Where will he sleep now? And where's that pesky wire?

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: While playing baseball, Weasy hits a ball out of bounds. It lands on a scary scarecrow, which frightens the ducklings. Weasy makes fun of them, but he's scared, too! He leaves without the ball but refuses to admit that he’s afraid.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: The heroes quest on Spookyween to stop whatever is menacing the pumpkin patch and find that a headless skeleton is using pumpkins as a head.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a magic hat that can transform them to match their costumes.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck and Frog are excited when they get a job as movie extras. But they end up destroying every take, irritating the director, who has a very short fuse.

programme.title: Bro's in Control
programme.desc: Can Joe and Adam scare Traitors stars Freddie Fraser and Jessie Roux?

programme.title: Gladiators: Epic Pranks
programme.desc: Nitro and Viper team up with Carys for a spooky Halloween prank on her friends. They face a farting vampire, spooky scares in the dark and a nightmare factory full of surprises!

programme.title: Stage Stars
programme.desc: With Halloween approaching, the Year 7s have been told about the school ghost and set off to hunt for it. Meanwhile, the Anything Goes cast try not to get too spooked by the thought of opening night for their show, and Encore - the most senior dancers at the school - warm up for their next big show.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Topical news magazine for children.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Shini, Abby and Hacker celebrate Halloween at a spooktacular theme park, testing which attraction is scariest and showing us how to make tasty vampire teeth treats!

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall heads to Oman in search of the most cryptically camouflaged animals of the underwater world. They range from leopard sharks to the octopus, and cuttlefish to a giant moray eel.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the growing season draws to a close, it’s time to catch up with Adam Frost in his new garden - and he’s been busy. The base of the greenhouse is now in, and there’s turf to lay, soft fruit to get in the ground and a shady border to plant up. In the Peak District, Rekha Mistry offers up some more timely advice on how to grow veg in pots, while Rachel de Thame heads to Nottinghamshire to revel in that autumn stalwart, the hardy chrysanthemum. The wonderful world of Japanese maples comes under the spotlight as a mother and daughter share their love of these beautiful trees. And Advolly Richmond delves into the colourful history behind the gardens at Blenheim Palace.

programme.title: Odette
programme.desc: The stirring true story of a courageous Frenchwoman who returned to her occupied homeland to spy for the Special Operations Executive during the Second World War.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: Marcus steps things up with a hunt for the perfect cow. He heads to Shropshire in search of a rare breed that has been around in England for centuries, the English Longhorn. A close encounter with a bull isn’t enough to put him off after he tastes the delicious product. Back on the farm, he harvests his own horseradish before developing a special recipe for horseradish sauce. While some goes in the cupboard, much of it forms Marcus’s contribution to a sharing event with the local community down at the village pub. And once the new Longhorns are in place, it's time for a special celebration meal with beef at its very heart.

programme.desc: Nadiya shares some deliciously simple family bakes, from daughter Maryam’s ultimate jam and chocolate flapjacks to an easy, oven-baked chilli topped with crunchy tortillas.

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Relive some of the biggest hits of 1996 with these Top of the Pops classic performances. Summer hits were aplenty with Peter Andre, Gina G and Los Del Rio all bringing sunshine to Elstree. Hooks in hip-hop proved dominant with Dr Dre, Blackstreet, Mark Morrison, Toni Braxton and the Fugees all scoring huge hits. Britpop was still booming, with Oasis continuing to dominate singles sales with Sleeper hot on their heels. Global dance classics were born courtesy of Faithless and Robert Miles, and add into the mix the awesome arrival of Spice Girls, plus many more, and it’s not a year to miss. Artists featured include Spice Girls, Suede, The Fugees, Babylon Zoo, Beautiful South, Mark Morrison, Sleeper, Los Del Rio, Peter Andre, Alanis Morrisette, Manics, Dr Dre, Blackstreet, Robret Miles, Space, OMC, Garbage, Gina G, Kula Shaker, Toni Braxton, Babybird and Oasis.

programme.desc: Derek is island-hopping in this round-up of his favourite Welsh island walks. He goes wild in west Wales as he sails to Skomer Island – a national nature reserve of international importance due to its seabirds - where he gets a close-up view of the puffins, razorbills and guillemots before staying up late to see the Manx shearwater. Next, Derek goes to Flat Holm Island, where he braves a huge colony of seagulls and discovers more about the island's past, including some Victorian gun placements. Lastly, Derek heads up north to Wales's largest island, Anglesey, where he visits another tiny island with a secluded chapel, an unexpected motor racing track, a neolithic burial chamber and a sauna on a beach.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt dishes up a feast of food from the Saturday Kitchen archives to whet the appetite for the week ahead. The Hairy Bikers bring comfort food bang up to date with sticky Szechuan lamb, stuffed into pillowy soft bao buns, with a fresh hit of pickled carrots, spring onion and herbs – cosy comfort with a fragrant Asian twist! Meera Sodha introduces a taste of Sri Lanka to the studio as she continues the comfort theme with her warming lentil and coconut dal with crispy mustard kale. Jeremy Lee brings his effervescent charm and wit to the kitchen whilst giving an underused cut of meat its chance in the spotlight. He makes a rich steamed kid pudding that melts in the mouth. Mary McCartney celebrates Bonfire Night with her flavour-packed smoky dogs, while Carmen O’Neal and Idris Elba team up to serve a masterclass in brandy. And queen of puddings Nigella Lawson tucks into either her food heaven, scallops, or her food hell, candied fruit. Meanwhile, Rick Stein explores the New Forest's bounty of produce, and the Hairy Bikers make a Menorcan dish in the Mediterranean Sea.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Sitting between Germany and France, Alsace is frontier land with a cuisine to match. In Strasbourg, Eva stops off at Brasserie Le Tigre for a beer (brassier means ‘to brew’) and a deliciously creamy tarte flambee. Then there's a trip to guide Coralie Andt’s restaurant, known as a winstub, where French wines can be enjoyed with plenty of cheese and sausage – as well as more sausage with sauerkraut cooked in white Riesling wine. With French tarts in a brasserie that serves German-style beer, and German sausage in a winstub serving French white wine, Alsace is defined by its competing national influences.

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever
programme.desc: With Britain more obsessed with baking than ever, actress and cake expert Jane Asher brings together a selection of recipes from the nation's favourite television chefs, for Best Bakes Ever. Each episode gives baking fans another chance to experience classic dishes from the likes of the James Martin, Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, the Hairy Bikers, Raymond Blanc, Nigella Lawson, Tom Kerridge, Lorraine Pascale and Rachel Khoo. There's added insight and appreciation from Jane herself too. Whether its cakes, pies, puddings or main courses - this greatest hits of baking is a must for anyone with a need to knead, and should help inspire even more of us to start getting creative in the kitchen.

programme.title: I Was Monty's Double
programme.desc: World War II drama. A low-ranking officer who resembles General Montgomery is recruited to play his double in an elaborate plan to trick the Nazis.

programme.title: Women's Super League
programme.desc: Women's Super League action as Charlton Athletic face Chelsea.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin introduces a collection of the best finds from the show's travels to Lulworth Castle in Dorset, Chiddingstone Castle in Kent, and Wrest Park in Bedfordshire. The antiques experts include Catherine Southon, Christina Trevanion, Adam Partridge, Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, with items ranging from a cloisonne vase to an astonishing collection of First World War slides. Paul also finds out more about the ancient art of shipbuilding at Buckler's Hard in Hampshire.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: For a live demonstration of terroir, Eva heads to Domaine Dujac, home of the current most-wanted Burgundy wine. Standing on one side of a road, owner Jeremy Seysses points to a parcel of grand cru (the very best) of Clos de la Roche. On the other side is a premier cru (the next best) - a Gevrey-Chambertin Combottes. Back at the winery, Eva tucks into beef cheeks bathed in Domaine Dujac for a classic boeuf bourguignon lunch. Despite the grapes being grown just a few metres away, these reds are a class apart.

programme.title: Wild Horses, the Rockies and Me

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob are back in Norfolk - a bittersweet return, as this was the very first location where Ted joined them. They both reminisce about Ted and raise a cup in his memory - although Ted would have preferred a biscuit. They head to some prime Norfolk lakes, hoping to catch a bream. It’s been well documented that Bob is not a fan of the bream, but will a big catch make him change his tune? It's Paul and Bob's birthday week, and they consider whether they may celebrate any further milestones or simply let them pass. Bob ends up throwing a surprise 70s-themed birthday party for Paul on the roof of the Blickling Estate, once owned by the Boleyn family.

Later, in a packed Irish pub, the music starts – and staying on the sidelines proves impossible.

As the deadline approaches, Harminder’s father escapes arrest and schoolboy Paresh hides during overnight curfews while gunfire echoes across the city. Britain is divided. Controversial politician Enoch Powell rallies those who say the Ugandan Asians have no right to come, a newspaper poll finds just six per cent of the public want them here, and some councils try to steer new arrivals away from their cities. In Uganda, Amin refuses to negotiate – stepping up the pressure on those stuck in the country.

We also get a chance to see right inside Dr Xand’s nostrils when he sticks a camera up his nose to show Dr Chris a real-life, flapping bogey specimen - gross alert! Dr Ronx makes a whole class of schoolchildren forget where their elbows are with a mind-blowing body trick you can try on your friends, and in Ouch and About, Ethan wants to know which is the strongest bone in his body. Over in Australia, six-year-old Jakobi is flown by helicopter to Sydney by the Flying Doctors because his local hospital thinks he needs specialist care. programme.title: Horrible Histories
programme.desc: Did you know that the Victorians invented films? Not only that, but one of the first stars of the moving image was Queen Victoria! Using real footage recently restored by the BFI, this special show takes a Horribly Historical look at the Victorians’ obsession with film. We see some of Queen Vicky’s very first filmic appearances (also featuring an initially reluctant Tsar Nicholas I), and also how the Victorians became obsessed with filming everything, from their holidays abroad to strapping cameramen to the front of a moving train (using only ropes) to make ‘Phantom Ride’ films. Along the way we also meet the Lumiere brothers (one of whom looks a lot like First Dates' Fred Sirieix), Kaiser Wilhelm II, notable Victorian actor Herbert Beerbohm Tree, and we see that the Victorians were also early adopters of Fake News. The episode ends with a show-stopping song that traces the evolution of film from the Victorians’ first forays through to the blockbusters we see in the multiplexes today.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Plastic is one of the greatest inventions in human history. It makes so much of our lives possible, but how we dispose of it is now a massive problem. By the year 2050 it’s thought that there will be more plastic than fish in our seas. So what can we do about it? First, ditch the disposable plastic water bottle and go for tap water in a reusable bottle. Better for the environment and cheaper too! Next, join a beach clean. It may seem like this problem is too big for us to handle but many hands make light work. Reduce, reuse and, importantly, recycle. And even more importantly than that, don’t drop litter. A bag that is thrown on the streets of London could end up on the coast of Africa or in the belly of a whale or a turtle. Lastly and most importantly, know that every single person can make a difference. One single plastic bag could choke a turtle or sunfish. One plastic straw could be the end of a gorgeous, iconic animal, so know you have power and use it.

programme.desc: It's picnic day! Rebecca and Murphi create a 'soup-er' fly in a bowl of soup. On the Recycling Express, an old storage tub becomes a totally terrific tub drum kit.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Raa Raa always scratches his claws in the morning, but his scratching post has fallen apart. He sets off to find himself a new one in the jungliest bit. When he does eventually find a new scratching post, it is huge. How is he going to get it home again?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bored of the local playground, Dad and the kids go out bushwalking on a journey to their local creek. Cast out of her comfort zone, Bluey's eyes are opened to the beauty of the natural world.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are excited to go to a black-and-white gala at King Tiger's house. On arrival, they're impressed with King Tiger's party crown and its resplendent red ruby centrepiece, even if his composure is somewhat ruined by frequent and giant sneezes. The Squirrels set about testing out Duggee's golden rules for party etiquette by mingling with fellow guests but get a suspiciously lukewarm response. When King Tiger suddenly cries out that his ruby has gone missing, the party turns into a mystery to be solved. Luckily, Duggee has his Mystery Badge! The Squirrels gather everyone together to examine the evidence of their suspicious behaviour and narrow down the list of potential culprits to... King Tiger! Or rather to his giant sneezes, which made the ruby come loose and fly into a trifle. King Tiger is reunited with his ruby, the Squirrels get their Mystery Badges, and everyone gets to eat the trifle!

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Brooke finds out all about one of the UK’s favourite birds – robins. Chantelle is with Kabir at a nature reserve listening out for different kinds of birds while Rory and his son Sandy are in the garden digging for worms and bird spotting. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files explain why robins have a red breast, what colour robin chicks are and why robins are on Christmas cards. It’s also time to find out what robins do for the planet as pest controllers. This episode’s Teeny Tiny Task is to help the birds by making a bird feeder.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Kyra and Khloe have some garden fun planned. First, they visit a garden centre to buy some new plants, before heading back home to plant them. It’s hard work, but Kyra is sure her flowers will grow to be nice and big. With the garden in full bloom, the sisters open their own garden juice bar and get busy squeezing fresh fruit juice. But what will Mum and Dad think of their tangy creation?

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen is playing with her toy train set, but she really wants to go on a real steam train. Tess the train driver comes to visit, Small flies off to see how leeks grow, and they make a choo-choo party platter for their special guest.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: When guide dog Kika has a waggy tail-related accident with a purple smoothie, she and her owner Dr Amit visit the Woofton Library of Things to borrow a carpet cleaner.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet Tapon the pygmy hippo, who is ten times smaller than a regular hippo. He might be tiny, but he has a huge appetite. The pair feed this cute character his breakfast. Next, they meet a pair of aardvarks, Terry and Dobby. These two terrific diggers use their super long tongues to lap up their lunch. Hippos and aardvarks are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: What’s in Your Bag?
programme.desc: Canoeist Jack, who has raced in competitions all around the world, tells us all about how his paddles help him move quickly through the water.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: It’s Waffle’s first ever after-school club, and Waffle is tentative about the new experience - until class friends Daisy and Cole help him join in with an impromptu hoop hunt.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona, Baba and Mossy babysit a little egg and help find its mama and papa.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: It’s the first day of spring, so it’s time for the traditional march round the garden to greet the daffodils. But none of the gang can remember the right tempo to march to. Can Yukee find a way to get them all marching in time?

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu can't understand why Gus is afraid of the vacuum cleaner.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: The Piggies put on a big concert so that all of Fine Forest can hear Cherry's amazing voice. They build a huge stage and everything is almost ready - but Cherry has no song to sing!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One's idea of fun is singing, dancing and making friends by adding One. Learn to count to ten by adding one with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Somehow, P, O and P have popped I's dot, and she is not very happy. Can O and friends find it again before I loses her cool - or will things go from bad to worse? This episode has fun with the letters O, I, C, D, P and T, and the words pop, cod, cot, cop, pot, pod and dot.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Mr Tumble needs to give Tumble Ted a bubble bath after a jammy mishap at breakfast. Meanwhile, Justin and his friends have lots of fun blowing bubbles.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. Tinky Winky finds a party invitation and shows it to Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po. The invitation takes flight, and the Teletubbies follow it to find a Tiddlytubbies' party.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: After lots of stomping through the forest, baby elephant Kipekee feels tired. Hamza sees some lively baboons in the wild, and the rhinos enjoy a special kind of bath – a mud bath!

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Maddie goes for a drive in the car. She uses a special microscope camera to find out how car brakes work. An animation shows how the brake pedal is connected to the brake discs and pads and how they move to slow down and stop the car. Next, Maddie visits a factory to see how a car is made from a large roll of steel sheeting. She uses special cameras to show how robots work with people to put the different parts of the cars together.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this exciting episode, CBeebies' very own motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that all fly! Grace first goes wingwalking, then shows off the incredible harrier jump jet before flying a gyroplane!

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Lucas and his classmates are learning to write the letter ‘t’ for tiger. After watching how it’s done by Mrs Collins, Lucas helps his friend Otto. The children discover the classroom is in a mess and a spot tiger paw print on the floor. Could it be a toy tiger causing havoc in the school? Lucas has an idea to track down the toy tiger - leaving out pictures and some food. But will it work?

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ava learns to roller skate. Luckily, big sister Eden is on hand with some advice.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: When Ginger gets a nasty tummy ache, the Pea-Rexes have to find a special soothing herb.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. A poisonous sea krait lays her eggs in the garden pod, just as Captain Barnacles has to navigate the ship past a treacherous whirlpool.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter promises to find the mice a new home, locating an alternative mouse house proves to be an adventure in itself.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside. Roly is digging in the garden when his spade suddenly hits something. It's a key. But what does it do? Duggee has his key badge and says they can find out through trial and error. The Squirrels go on an adventure to work out what the key opens and what could be inside.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: When Nugget’s favourite teddy bear gets accidentally washed by Pancake, the Piripenguins try to restore its unique smell by painstakingly recreating Nugget’s happiest memories.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea blows all the lanterns away during the Lantern Festival. Supertato struggles to get them all back and needs Broccoli’s help to save the day.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy sends the Ducklings to bed, but they want to keep watching TV. They find an invisibility ray and use it to stay up without Weasy seeing - but he soon catches on to their scheme!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Felix the pig is stuck on a cliff ledge where not even Mojo’s tops can reach him. They will need to be creative to get Bo up there and save that poor pig!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey, Bingo and their friends have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Muffin is told that she is special by her Dad, she uses it as an excuse to do anything she wants, which means playing Bluey and Bingo’s library game her way.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Boom hasn’t been sleeping and is so tired he crashes into a tree. Zog and the doctors try everything to get him back to sleep.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: It’s the Balamory dance, but Ava is struggling to dance like everyone else. Inspired by the Harbour Master, Ava invents her own moves, which everyone at the nursery soon follows.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Evie's mum Jess has just married Doug's dad Simon. The new family get home to discover a lost puppy hiding in their wedding presents. Evie wants to keep him and call him Waffle.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: It's Yes Day, so Dash and Jake say yes to everything Rafi asks - until she realises that doing less can sometimes mean you enjoy it more.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: Great-Gran Gran shows JoJo an old family photo – it's fun spotting Gran Gran, Mummy and Great-Gran Gran when they were younger. JoJo recognises some people, but there are lots of members of her family that she’s never met before. Gran Gran has an idea for a Gran Gran plan – they can use the family photos to make their very own family tree. But who is on the missing photo, and why are they so important to JoJo?

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Scarf Lady's jukebox inspires a knitted instrument band.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Three pale things - a shell, a spiral and a cone - drift towards the planet seeking music, heat and light to revive them. Tiny and Small have seen them before and know just what to do. Will they be able to revive the new pale star-shaped thing?

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: BaBa shares some crayons with MeMo. Gramma Leeba praises this kindness. BaBa enjoys the praise and shares all the crayons until there are none left. At the Play Tree, BaBa shares all the felt flowers with the Tweeties, and at Yummy Time, BaBa shares a whole pie. There is none left, so the Yummies share some of their pie with BaBa - how kind!

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read bedtime stories. Igglepiggle and Upsy Daisy go for a very long walk. Feeling tired, they decide to return by Ninky Nonk - and have a very bouncy ride.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Tom Hardy reads a Bedtime Story about a little mouse with a big personality.

programme.title: Duel of Dragons
programme.desc: Doi frati gemeni, separati la nastere, ajung unul pianist la New York si altul gangster in Hong Kong. Cand pianistul calatoreste la Honk Kong pentru un concert, cei doi sunt confundati unul cu celalat.

programme.title: Triplu X: Întoarcerea lui Xander Cage
programme.desc: Când mai mulți mercenari fură o armă hi-tech, lumea are nevoie de spionul Xander Cage. Recrutat din nou, Xander conduce o echipă de oameni dependenți de adrenalină ca să salveze planeta.

programme.title: Greu de pensionat
programme.desc: Un fost agent CIA compensează aventurile de odinioară cu o existenţă cât mai liniştită. Problemele încep în ziua când un asasin încearcă să-l ucidă. Frank apelează la echipa sa de odinioară (Freeman, Mirren, John Malkovich) pentru a lichida asasinul.

programme.title: Dragonul: Viața lui Bruce Lee
programme.desc: Filmul se bazeaza in intregime pe relatarile vaduvei Linda Lee Caldwell si e o poveste fascinanta ce reda viata trepidanta a lui Bruce Lee, maestrul luptelor martiale care era pe punctul de a deveni star international cand a murit, in mod misterios.

programme.title: Ape ucigașe
programme.desc: Tânăra Haley Keller încearcă să-și salveze tatăl după ce orașul în care trăiesc este lovit de un uragan de categoria 5, însă se trezește blocată în casa înconjurată de ape pline de aligatori fioroși în căutare de pradă.

programme.title: Curierul
programme.desc: O frumoasă curier din Londra descoperă că unul dintre pachetele pe care trebuie să le livreze conține o bombă.

programme.title: Jaful de pe Baker Street
programme.desc: Un vânzător de maşini cu un trecut dubios, Terry, a evitat întotdeauna loviturile mari. Dar cand Martine, o cunoştinţă din copilărie, îi spune cum să prade inexpugnabila bancă din Baker Street, Terry nu ratează ocazia.

programme.title: My Way
programme.desc: În Coreea celui de-al Doilea Război Mondial, doi alergători rivali, unul coreean (Jang Dong-gun) și unul japonez (Joe Odagiri), merg împreună la război împotriva sovieticilor.

programme.title: De-a șoarecele și pisica
programme.desc: Alan e nevoit sa-si anuleze o vacanta de familie, pentru a prinde un gigolo ce seduce doamne varsnice pentru a le usura de bijuterii. Cand hotul devine martor la o crima, el si Parker devin parteneri, in efortul de a-i prinde pe adevaratii baieti rai

programme.title: Cele trei dorințe ale Cenușăresei
programme.desc: Povestea clasică a Cenușăresei: în mijlocul unei păduri acoperite de zăpezi, eroina se luptă cu mama vitregă, care se pune în calea visului fetei de a-l întâlni pe Făt-Frumos. O călătorie plină de emoții, aventuri, arcași și un bal la palatul regal.

programme.title: Beowulf - legenda vikingilor
programme.desc: In regatul danez, intr-o perioada in care numerosii zei ai nordului incep sa cedeze teren in fata unuia singur, Christos, un cavaler fidel regelui sau este trimis sa omoare un monstru, Grendel.

programme.title: Valea florilor
programme.desc: O legenda despre iubirea dintre doi tineri, Jalan si Ushna, despre lupta lor cu ineluctabila moarte, despre iubirea ce strabate secolele si lumea si care incepe in tinuturile din l'Himalaya, in secolul al XIX lea si ajunge in Japonia zilelor noastre.

programme.title: Ninja din Beverly Hills
programme.desc: Un copil e salvat de câţiva ninja care văd în el împlinirea unei profeţii. În ciuda îndeletnicirilor lor, luptătorii cresc bebeluşul cu simţ de răspundere. Haru, cum a fost numit de "părinţii" adoptivi, pare a fi departe de a deveni şi el un Ninja.

programme.title: Cactus Jack
programme.desc: Un cowboy (Arnold Schwarzenegger) o escortează pe domnișoara Jones pentru a obține o sumă de bani considerabilă de la tatăl ei. Dar bogătașul Avery Simpson vrea să pună mâna pe bani și îl angajează pe Jack (Kirk Douglas) să îi jefuiască.

programme.title: Monstrul din Lake Placid
programme.desc: O moarte suspecta, un fragment de os, amintind de un animal preistoric, sunt la inceput doar cateva elemente ce trezesc curiozitatea si interesul unui grup de cercetatori care sosesc in mica asezare de langa Lake Placid.

programme.title: Asasinul sufletului
programme.desc: Un bărbat moare ca parte a unui program militar experimental. Un fost soldat de operațiuni secrete îi ia locul pentru a afla cine l-a ucis.

programme.title: Omul din întuneric 2
programme.desc: Norman Nordstrom locuieşte cu Phoenix, în vârstă de 11 ani. El a recreat familia care i-a fost furată de o şoferiţă beată. Însă atunci când oaspeţi nedoriţi vin din nou la el acasă, Norman va arăta ce zace în el, în noi şi neaşteptate moduri

programme.title: Dușmănia
programme.desc: Eliberat conditionat, Cain Burgess vrea sa se razbune pe cei responsabili de transformarea lui intr-un criminal cu sange rece. Este o luptă epică, sângeroasă, in căutarea sufletului pe care l-a pierdut cu ani în urmă pe străzile unui oraș neiertător.

programme.title: Gardă de corp
programme.desc: Un fost ofiter de marinã ajunge la noul loc de muncã într-o tarã din Europa de Est și se vede în mijlocul unei scene sângeroase: rebeli puternic înarmati l-au ucis pe ambasadorul Statelor Unite si amenintã sã distrugã recent stabilita democratie.

programme.title: Teroare în paradis
programme.desc: Câţiva tineri cu diverse probleme sunt înscrişi într-un aşa-zis program de reabilitare în Fiji, unde, odată ajunşi, realizează că se află într-o tabără de tip închisoare unde urmează să fie abuzaţi atât fizic cât şi psihic

programme.title: Eu și Marley
programme.desc: John si Jennifer s-au casatorit de curand, dar nu vor sa intre prea repede in lumea responsabilitatilor familiale asa ca, in loc de un copil, au ales sa se ingrijeasca de un caine. Marley este un labrador adorabil.

programme.title: Podul de pe râul Kwai
programme.sub-title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
programme.desc: După ce prizonierii britanici au construit un pod de cale ferată important în Burma ocupată de inamic, comando-urile Aliaţilor primesc misiunea de a-l distruge, într-una dintre cele mai memorabile experienţe cinematografice ale tuturor timpurilor.

programme.title: Laleaua neagră
programme.desc: Paris, inainte de izbucnirea revolutiei din 1789. Guillaume de Saint-Preux, om cinic, crud si egoist, profitand de atmosfera furtunoasa, dar si confuza din tara, prada nobilimea, sub numele de Laleaua Neagra.

programme.title: Omul-Păianjen
programme.desc: Filmul Spider-Man (Omul-Paianjen) se axează pe povestea elevului Peter Parker (Tobey Maguire) care, după ce a fost mușcat de un păianjen modificat genetic, capătă o putere supraomenească.

programme.title: Greu de pensionat
programme.desc: Un fost agent CIA compensează aventurile de odinioară cu o existenţă cât mai liniştită. Problemele încep în ziua când un asasin încearcă să-l ucidă. Frank apelează la echipa sa de odinioară (Freeman, Mirren, John Malkovich) pentru a lichida asasinul.

programme.title: Regele Cobra
programme.desc: O echipa de oameni de stiinta condusi de doctorul Irwin Burns (Joseph Ruskin) incearca sa produca intr-un laborator un drog menit sa controleze nivelul de violenta si agresivitate atat la om cat si la animale.

programme.title: Echipa Mortii
programme.desc: Un virus misterios a ucis miliarde de oameni si i-a transformat pe multi altii in zombi insetati de sange. Incapabil sa opreasca virusul, guvernul dezvolta un joc video, „Dead Trigger”, care reflecta evenimentele terifiante care au loc in lume.

programme.title: Ultima redută
programme.desc: Last Stand spune povestea lui Ray Owens (Arnold Schwarzenegger), un şerif dintr-un oraş american de la graniţa cu Mexicul, hotărât să ţină piept cu orice preţ traficanţilor de droguri care-şi fac de cap în jurisdicţia sa

programme.title: Ape ucigașe
programme.desc: Tânăra Haley Keller încearcă să-și salveze tatăl după ce orașul în care trăiesc este lovit de un uragan de categoria 5, însă se trezește blocată în casa înconjurată de ape pline de aligatori fioroși în căutare de pradă.

programme.title: Omul din întuneric 2
programme.desc: Norman Nordstrom locuieşte cu Phoenix, în vârstă de 11 ani. El a recreat familia care i-a fost furată de o şoferiţă beată. Însă atunci când oaspeţi nedoriţi vin din nou la el acasă, Norman va arăta ce zace în el, în noi şi neaşteptate moduri

programme.title: Sacrificiu din dragoste
programme.desc: Avocatul James White merge cu logodnica sa la părinții ei, la țară. Dorind să-l impresioneze pe tatăl ei, pretinde că este un cowboy și jucător de cărți desăvârșit, dar respectul lui Karl se castigă mult mai greu decât își imaginase...

programme.title: Dinheiro a Quanto Obrigas

programme.title: O Fruto Proibido T3 - Ep. 79

programme.title: Amor Eterno T1 - Ep. 85

programme.desc: Os membros do Fallen Angels Murder Club procuram respostas sobre a morte misteriosa de um dos seus. Hollis acaba por se encontrar no centro da investigação quando um jornalista que estava a cobrir o caso também aparece morto.

programme.title: Flores de Aço (1989)

Isto impede-o de poder aproximar-se dos humanos, a não ser para criar revolucionários cortes de cabelos.

programme.title: Outlander T6 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Amo-te Até À Morte
programme.desc: A relação simbiótica entre a mãe Camile, que sofre de síndrome de Munchausen, e a sua filha Esme termina de forma trágica quando Esme descobre a verdade sobre o seu verdadeiro estado físico.

programme.title: Přepadení 2: Temné území
programme.desc: Mistr bojových umění, bývalý příslušník speciálních jednotek a skvělý kuchař Casey Ryback se na nádraží setká se svou neteří Sarah a společně nastoupí do luxusního vlaku Grand Continental. Ten krátce po odjezdu přepadne komando zabijáků, vedených geniálním vynálezcem Travisem. Zavraždí strojvůdce i další personál, cestující vezmou jako rukojmí a zřídí ve vlaku řídicí centrum, s jehož pomocí se zmocní smrtonosné satelitní zbraně, kterou kdysi Travis vymyslel. Hrozí, že srovná Washington se zemí, pokud mu vláda nevyplatí miliardu dolarů. Protože se vlak pohybuje, nedokáže armáda únosce zaměřit, a tak je opět jedinou šancí pro miliony lidí kuchař, kterému se podařilo uniknout ze spárů teroristů. Když Ryback zjistí, co je ve hře, pustí se s pomocí černého kuchaře Bobbyho neohroženě do boje. Jenže pak se štěstí začne obracet. Odpočítávání začalo a Ryback má poslední šanci, jak zabránit krveprolití.

programme.title: Predátor z hlubin
programme.desc: Klidné říční vody náhle rozčeří mohutný lidožravý zabiják, který hledá stále nové oběti. Na břehu zanechává děsivou stopu a místní lidé se pokouší odhalit, kdo nebo co za tímto masakrem vězí. Ohromný, geneticky upravený predátor může žít pod vodou i na souši, je rychlý a má hlad... V Louisiana Bayou se skrývá něco krvežíznivého. Nikdy předtím neexistovalo něco takového. Mohutná, geneticky upravená a masožravá ryba čeří klidné říční vody a hledá nové oběti. Na břehu zanechává děsivou stopu, znetvořená těla, a místní lidé se pokouší odhalit, kdo nebo co za tímto masakrem vězí. Brzy zjistí, že nejde o obyčejného predátora - tento lidožravý zabiják předčí všechny předchozí šůdce. Výplod vědy s hadím tělem může žít pod vodou i na souši, Frankenfish může pronásledovat lidi všude. Je rychlý. A má hlad.

programme.title: Chraň nás od zlého
programme.desc: Newyorský policista Ralph Sarchie (Eric Bana), který se sám potýká s vlastními problémy, se ve snímku Chraň nás od zlého, pouští do vyšetřování série znepokojivých a nevysvětlitelných zločinů. Spojí své síly s nekonvenčním knězem (Edgar Ramírez), odborníkem na vymítací rituály, aby společně bojovali s nočními děsy a případy démonického posednutí, které ohrožují jejich město. Film se inspiroval knihou, která popisuje Sarchieho skutečné mrazivé případy.
